lead: Two to six figures, such as headcount, years of service, languages or qualifications. With more than four, a team starts to read like statistics.

stats.title: The number is the term
stats.text: Each figure is a description list entry, and the label below defines the number.

stats.title: The unit sits beside it
stats.text: It is smaller and lighter, so the number stands out.

stats.title: The icon is a key
stats.text: Each figure names an icon such as star or globe, so a new icon set needs no template change.

stats.title: A line starts each figure
stats.text: A divider between two columns would split the band in the middle.
